$Comment: The Hallowed set's look and its fire ward, held on the player while the set's tier is on (GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json names it). DamageResistance takes 15 percent off Fire damage: burning, lava and a Lantern Bomb's flames all deal Fire. The look is a slow orange shimmer over the wearer (the model effect Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Glow) with a few warm sparks. Infinite with OverlapBehavior Ignore, as a set effect must be: the set engine puts it on when the tier comes on and again at every login, and takes it off itself. Never apply this id from anything else.
